about: Vertical layout overrides for pipeline/edit/shorts-build.mjs. graphics.<name>.mode: stack (default) | fill (9:16 crop, x = subject centre 0-1). overlays.<name>.mode: map (default over a graphic: stays where it was drawn) | box (default over Ben: parts cut out by region [x0,y0,x1,y1] fractions of the 16:9 frame and moved into zone [x,y,w,h] of the 1080x1920 frame) | pin (box, over any layout). react: the vertical clip Ben reacts to (source time = in + (t - at)). skip: long-cut overlays left out (chapter cards always are). tighten: dead-air pass (defaults in the builder); keepPauses: final-cut ranges whose pauses stay. platforms: one output per platform, each with its call-out render; cta: call-out placement and timing.
